_comment: The one validated figure palette for this repository. Values were checked with the dataviz reference validator on the light surface before first use; the check is recorded in Thesis/gate2_05_cardoso_2026/trials/c5_figures_for_the_three_findings/c5_run_record.json. Read this file rather than hard-coding colours, so a figure anywhere in the tree cannot drift from the validated set. Colour follows the entity, never its rank; text uses the ink tokens, never a series colour.
_history: Externalised from Thesis/gate2_05_cardoso_2026/trials/viz_style.py on 2026-09-13, when the reference-aligned epithelial panels turned out to use ad hoc viridis values. Values are unchanged from that module, so no existing figure changes appearance.

_validation.checked: 2026-09-13, dataviz validate_palette.js, categorical slots 1 to 4 on the light surface
_validation.result: all checks pass: lightness band, chroma floor, CVD separation (worst adjacent pair delta E 9.1 protan), normal-vision floor (22.9)
_validation.warning_and_its_relief: contrast against the surface is below 3:1 for the green and amber slots, which obliges visible labels or a table view rather than colour alone. Every figure using these slots carries direct labels, and the reference-aligned panels also ship epithelial_primary_markers_by_cluster.csv as the table view.
_validation.sequential_ramp_note: one hue, light to dark, monotonic; use it for magnitude only, never for identity
